entities.summary: Kimberly Jessica Newell, also known by the Chinese name Zhou Jiaying, is a Chinese-Canadian ice hockey player and member of the Chinese national ice hockey team. She most recently played in the 2021–22 season of the Zhenskaya Hockey League (ZhHL) with the KRS Vanke Rays.
